review_scope.excluded_run_reason: r1 is explicitly FAILED_OR_INCOMPLETE_DO_NOT_CITE and dev is not a sealed evidence run

prosperity.comparison: Prosperity presents real-time product-sparsity identification, broad model/dataset evaluation, a cycle-accurate simulator and memory-aware commercial-flow evaluation; its reported gains are end-to-end comparisons, not a selector-local opportunity ratio.

phi.comparison: Phi combines hierarchical pattern sparsity, offline weight preprocessing, pattern-aware fine-tuning and a dedicated architecture, then reports speed, energy and normalized implementation comparisons.

external_reference_standard.admission_rule: M64 may be described as a verified enabling RTL mechanism only. DATE-level accelerator novelty or speedup requires real all10 integration, memory and scheduling cost, commercial implementation evidence, accuracy and equal-resource end-to-end baselines.

independent_oracle.generator: independently reimplemented 32-bit-masked xorshift32 with testbench word-interleaving order

independent_elastic_schedule_replay.interpretation: The campaign indirectly exercises the full elastic pop/advance/push case 38 times and output stability under 575 blocked-output cycles, but the driver deliberately inserts at least one bubble after every acceptance and therefore does not demonstrate the one-descriptor-per-cycle no-stall claim. The receipt field output_stall_cycles counts all modulo-pattern low cycles, including cycles with no valid output.

rtl_static_audit.tie_priority: strict less-than updates correctly preserve zero, left, up, previous priority
rtl_static_audit.invalid_boundaries: 9-bit 511 sentinel is unreachable by a 256-bit Hamming count and validity also gates comparison
rtl_static_audit.count_width_256: COUNT_W=9 represents 256, but the VCS campaign never selects a count of 256
rtl_static_audit.elastic_pipeline: ready equations and conditional state updates are consistent with a two-entry fall-through-ready elastic pipeline
rtl_static_audit.parent_data_cost: Despite the address-control wording, the block consumes three 256-bit parent operands, registers all three, computes three 256-bit XOR-popcounts and internally selects a 256-bit parent to form masks. Seed-SRAM read ports, banking, address generation, latency and energy remain external and unmeasured.
rtl_static_audit.parameter_guard: COUNT_W is user-parameterized but has no elaboration assertion requiring COUNT_W >= clog2(TILE_BITS+1)

novelty_and_story_judgment.standalone: Weak-to-moderate. A four-way exact Hamming argmin plus signed XOR decomposition is a useful implementation primitive, but it is not yet a sparsity method or accelerator architecture comparable in scope to Prosperity or Phi.
novelty_and_story_judgment.integrated_potential: Moderate. The strongest defensible story is online exact local-motion-temporal parent selection that removes an offline-oracle assumption in M53 and feeds a real M57 scheduler. That story becomes interesting only if the extra three-parent read/popcount/mux cost is amortized by measured end-to-end cycle and energy savings.
novelty_and_story_judgment.reason: No real-trace RTL cycle delta, seed-memory traffic, DC/STA/Formality, SAIF/PTPX, accuracy or equal-resource fixed/Prosperity/Phi-like comparison is admitted.

P1.finding: The sealed campaign is 4096 synthetic descriptors. M64 is not instantiated in M57; the current M57 replay covers only sample 0 and explicitly rejects system/full-network cycle admission. There is no M53 all10 parent-ID, tag, mask or cycle equivalence.
P1.impact: M64 cannot close the offline-oracle gap or support the 3.0849x/system-speedup story.
P1.minimal_fix: Insert M64 before the M57 schedule bridge, replay every M53 all10 descriptor in ordered trace order, compare parent ID/source count/add/subtract/tag transaction-by-transaction, and publish per-sample cycle conservation with no reorder/drop/duplication.

P1.finding: The address-control description omits the dominant enabling cost: every decision requires three 256-bit parent operands plus the target, three wide XOR-popcounts, wide parent state and an internal 256-bit selection for mask formation. No seed-SRAM ports, banks, addresses, conflicts, latency or energy are modeled.
P1.impact: Net speedup and energy benefit can reverse once parent reads and selector logic are included.
P1.minimal_fix: Freeze an address-timed banked seed-SRAM design, prove legal left/up/previous availability and timestep commits, record bytes and conflicts per descriptor, and include macro/CACTI plus SAIF/PTPX cost in the same cycle model.

P1.finding: Static RTL supports an elastic two-entry pipeline, but the testbench inserts a bubble after every accepted input, producing zero consecutive input handshakes. The full pop/advance/push path occurs only indirectly 38 times and is not an asserted or receipted throughput property. There is no M64 DC/STA/Formality result.
P1.impact: One 256-bit descriptor per cycle and timing closure of four popcount paths are not measured claims.
P1.minimal_fix: Add a sustained-valid full-rate burst plus adversarial ready transitions, assert acceptance/order/no-drop and one-per-cycle behavior, then run exact-SHA VCS, DC/STA and Formality at the integrated target period.

P1.finding: M64 reports correctness but no workload benefit after its own hardware/memory overhead, no accuracy result and no equal-resource fixed/local-only, M53-oracle, Prosperity or Phi-like baseline. The standalone mechanism is materially narrower than the algorithm-architecture co-design in Prosperity/Phi.
P1.impact: The block is not yet a DATE novelty or performance headline.
P1.minimal_fix: Measure selector-inclusive all10 cycles, traffic, area, frequency and energy, preserve accuracy, ablate candidate sets and banking, and compare end-to-end under a common process/frequency/resource/memory model.

P2.finding: The independent campaign reconstruction finds maximum selected source count 142 and zero selected count-256 cases, so the critical 9-bit endpoint is not dynamically tested.
P2.minimal_fix: Add an all-ones target with all nonzero parents invalid and require parent zero, count 256, all add bits and no subtract bits.

P2.finding: The receipted 1074 output_stall_cycles are all modulo-pattern cycles with out_ready low; only 575 have out_valid high and are actual blocked-output cycles.
P2.minimal_fix: Rename the first counter backpressure_pattern_low_cycles and separately receipt out_valid_and_not_ready_cycles.

P2.finding: SVA checks stall stability, mask disjointness and count conservation, but not argmin optimality, tie priority, invalid-boundary rejection, accepted-tag ordering, transaction conservation or sustained throughput. Its parent covers are not tag-correlated to the triggering input.
P2.minimal_fix: Bind a reference-cost scoreboard or assertions with accepted-input history and add no-drop/no-dup/order, boundary, tie and full-rate properties.

P2.finding: COUNT_W is parameterized without requiring enough bits for TILE_BITS; nondefault legal-looking parameter values can silently wrap popcounts or collide with the invalid sentinel.
P2.minimal_fix: Add an elaboration-time guard COUNT_W >= clog2(TILE_BITS+1), plus TAG_W/TILE_BITS sanity checks.

P2.finding: The producer receipt builder and validator seal exact counters and identities, but they do not independently regenerate the xorshift vectors or selection ledger; both trust the same VCS PASS line and testbench oracle.
P2.minimal_fix: Promote an independent Python oracle with frozen ledger SHA and negative tamper cases into the producer evidence chain.

must_pass: sustained-full-rate VCS/SVA including count-256 and boundary/tie attacks
M64-to-M57 all10 exact parent/tag/mask/ordering replay against M53
address-timed banked seed-SRAM feasibility and traffic/conflict accounting
exact-SHA M64-integrated DC/STA/Formality and SAIF/PTPX or macro-aware power
selector-inclusive end-to-end speedup, energy, area, accuracy and equal-resource baselines
